mechanism.claim: Recurring month-phase cash, collateral, payroll, and derivatives cycles create directional BTC demand at specific calendar dates. Directions learned only before 2023 should persist when BTC variation is elevated.
mechanism.side: frozen sign of the selected pre-2023 UTC day-of-month mean twelve-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVMPS uses the monthly 1..28 phase axis. It is not the failed intrawweek hour-slot model, a weekend rule, a turn-of-month hard-coded subset, a macro release, or any prior diagnostic control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed seven-day BTC variation causal rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: only eight of twenty-eight month-phase dates are eligible and the causal volatility gate further thins fixed 00:05 UTC entries

training_contract.label: log(open at entry plus twelve elapsed hours divided by entry open)
training_contract.slot_score: arithmetic mean of complete fit log-return labels
training_contract.selection: four largest strictly positive and four smallest strictly negative means; score then day integer tie break
training_contract.failure: terminal if either sign has fewer than four eligible slots

oos_clock.decision: each exact daily 00:00 UTC boundary from 2023-07-01 onward
oos_clock.eligibility: UTC day-of-month is one of eight frozen dates and seven-day variation rank>=0.65
oos_clock.variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m log returns over [decision-7d,decision))
oos_clock.variation_rank: strict-prior daily 00:00 midrank, current excluded, maximum 270, minimum 180
oos_clock.reservation: chronological half-open nonoverlap; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and novelty pass

stopping_rule: freeze preregistration, fit only pre-2023, commit model before OOS incidence, then terminal first failure with no slot count, date, sign, variation, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
